projects.title: In-house content, organic and paid
projects.oneliner: NYC's cult cookie brand. Every photo and video, every channel, for three years.
projects.role: Social Media Content Creator · sole in-house photo and video
projects.brief: Chip City sells a rotating weekly menu across its stores, its app, and the delivery platforms. Every weekly drop, new product, and brand collaboration needed photo and video, organic and paid, on a fixed schedule.
did: Concepted, shot, and edited all photo and video except graphic design, and partnered with the Creative Director to keep every channel on brand.
Shot collab launches with Eggo, Pop-Tarts, Pringles, Peeps, Philadelphia Cream Cheese, Recess, Graza, Bee Dolce, Loverboy, SNL 50th Anniversary and TBS.
Produced paid video and static ads every month, and made AI-assisted creative that ran live.
Made training and internal videos, an HR hiring video, new-location architecture photos, and brand activation coverage.
In my final months, built an AI chatbot that lets store staff look up baking procedures in plain language.
scope: 3–5 video ads and 10–15 static ads a month
Weekly menu videos and website updates
E-commerce photos for every new product

It works with DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Photoshop, Lightroom, and ComfyUI, so its output lands in my project files, ready to edit.

projects.title: US launch creative, studio to AI
projects.oneliner: A Polish mineral water brand's US launch. Real product photography, extended and animated with AI, checked against the real bottle.
projects.brief: Rodowita needed launch creative for the US market in a cool, desaturated forest look, across stills and motion, without the product drifting from what's on the shelf.
did: Shot the product in studio as the reference for everything after.
Extended and animated scenes with AI (Nano Banana, Photoshop Generative Extend, Runway, Veo), checking label, color, and shape against the real bottle at every step.
Refined every prompt in Wondr Forge, my prompt tool, before generating.

projects.title: Cookbook photography and a cooking series
projects.oneliner: A Puerto Rican chef's bestselling cookbook, a watch-party booklet, and the companion series.
projects.role: Photographer · cinematographer for Sabor y Sazón
projects.description: Chef Mia Castro is a Puerto Rican chef and cookbook author — Beat Bobby Flay champion, Hell's Kitchen standout, host of Ramsay in 10 — whose debut cookbook, Cocina Puerto Rico, became a bestseller. When Bad Bunny's Super Bowl halftime show put Puerto Rico in the spotlight, she moved fast: a picadera booklet, Puerto Rican snack recipes built for watch parties, exclusive to pre-orders. I shot every image in it. Now I'm behind the camera as cinematographer for Sabor y Sazón, the companion series that turns hand-picked recipes from the book into something you can watch, releasing now.

projects.title: Product photography and a TV spot
projects.oneliner: From one surfside food truck to Puerto Rico's largest açaí brand.
projects.description: Açaí Express went from one surfside food truck in San Juan to Puerto Rico's largest açaí brand. I shot product photography for them, and directed my first TV commercial — it aired during the Super Bowl broadcast in Puerto Rico.

projects.title: Opening video and menu photography
projects.description: Massi's Homemade Sandwiches runs on a simple premise: real food, made from scratch. Semolina sourdough baked in-house, fresh meats sourced with care, everything prepared by hand. When they called me to shoot their soft opening, I was in. A sandwich shop this proud of doing it right — and fully seed oil-free — is rare. After the opening, I shot their entire menu for the delivery apps.

projects.title: Menu, store, and operations
projects.description: Gyro King has held the same corner at 50 E. Fordham Road for over 50 years — same owner, same recipes. I shot part of the menu for DoorDash, then stayed for store and operations photos that show how the place works. The brief I gave myself: capture the raw essence of a Bronx institution.

projects.title: A commercial for two one-person food businesses
projects.description: When Joe & Joe and Atezar Cocina & Ahumado planned a collab, both were one-person operations running out of home kitchens. Atezar turned its smoked meat into sausages, Joe & Joe made the buns, and I shot the commercial in the mountains of Puerto Rico. Both businesses have grown into their own physical locations since, built on high-quality, unique products.

projects.client: Sobao by Los Cidrines & La Bodeguita de Manolo
projects.title: Bakery and speakeasy, product and social
projects.description: Sobao by Los Cidrines and La Bodeguita de Manolo share one address in San Juan. Sobao is the bakery and restaurant from Los Cidrines, an iconic Puerto Rico bakery name. The Bodeguita is the speakeasy hidden inside: a camouflaged door, moody ambiance, natural wood, exposed bulbs. I shot product photography and social video for both as one project.

projects.title: Brand activation recap
projects.description: Mela designed a set of special-edition Blue Moon labels, and the beer landed at a favorite Puerto Rico hangout. I shot the recap video for the activation — Mela, the crowd, the bottles.

projects.title: Brand activations, Puerto Rico
projects.description: Brand activation and event coverage in Puerto Rico for McDonald's and Pepsi.
